title: Worker string composition
summary: At 0x5c21d0 the cdecl wrapper appends the entire right narrow string to left and move-constructs the returned string into output, returning output. The two original thiscall string operations remain external dependencies. Call sites include 0x5c1847 and 0x76bdfa.
test_description: Differential i386 tests call both wrapper versions using accepted original string helpers. Heap destination strings cover empty and nonempty inputs, inline right strings, self append, and a range of lengths within existing capacity. Full fixtures and backing bytes are compared after normalizing transferred pointers; return identity, moved-from state, and FS head restoration are checked.
known_limits: Allocation and exception paths remain external and untested; inputs stay within existing capacity.
Inline move construction is not exercised because the original memmove IAT has no trusted binding in this task.
String helper implementations are external dependencies; no byte matching is claimed.
